heroLead: Take The Lead Services is run by Karina and Matt Hart: a registered veterinary nurse and a former Surrey Police officer turned dog trainer. Together with our team, we look after dogs across the Surrey–Hampshire border as if they were our own.
bodyHeading: Professional, trusted care built around your dog
bodyParagraphs: Karina is a qualified and registered veterinary nurse with years of small animal practice behind her. That means there's always a trained eye on health and safety, from spotting a problem early to managing medication with confidence. She later qualified in dog grooming at Merrist Wood and opened our grooming salon, The Stylish Dog, in Ash.

Matt left Surrey Police in 2018 to focus on dog training full time. He has trained with some of the industry's leading names and holds Scent Instructor and Scent Detection Dog Handler qualifications, and has handled operational detection dogs overseas.

Our wider team includes qualified trainers with deep knowledge of canine behaviour and body language, so we can tailor care to every dog. We run a 5★ licensed daycare centre and licensed home boarding, with safe crate transport for every dog in our care.
We've built a community of dog owners and animal lovers who value professionalism, reliability and genuine passion for dogs, and we're proud to support local charities and community events.
promiseHeading: What every dog gets with us
ctaText: The best way to see what makes us different is to meet us. Your introductory meeting and assessment are free.
